description: This file contains a PHP class for an OpenCart admin controller that manages a sale shipping report. It includes methods for displaying the report interface, saving report settings, and generating report data in various formats.

classes.name: SaleShipping
classes.description: A controller class for handling sale shipping reports within the OpenCart admin panel, providing UI management and data retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the sale shipping report configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings via AJAX POST request.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the actual sale shipping report based on filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of report data, likely in response to an AJAX request.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data in HTML format, including pagination and filtering.
